terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Terms of use for the stressindex.io website, the Stress Index app and the professional area, provided by {company}.

s01Subject.title: 1. The service

s02Account.title: 2. Account and requirements
s02Account.body:
Using the Professional Area requires a personal account, created on the registration page with first name, last name, email and profession. You warrant that the details you provide are accurate and keep them up to date.

The account is personal and cannot be transferred. Keep your credentials safe: you are responsible for every activity carried out with your account and must notify the Provider immediately at {email} of any unauthorized use.

End clients access the app through an invitation from the professional. The professional remains the sole point of contact in the relationship with their clients.

The service requires an up-to-date device and browser, an Internet connection and, for measurements, a compatible chest strap as listed in the Guides. Connection and hardware costs are borne by the user.

s03Trial.title: 3. Free trial and subscription
s03Trial.body:
Every new professional account starts with a 60-day free trial, during which the full service is available. At the end of the trial the service continues under the chosen subscription, at the price and billing period shown on the website at the time of subscription; prices are in euros, VAT excluded unless stated otherwise.

The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless cancelled. You can cancel at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period, and no refunds are given for periods already started.

The Provider may change the price list with at least 30 days' written notice; changes apply from the next renewal. Additional modules (for example Sport or Monitoring) may have their own pricing, shown at activation.

If payment fails, the Provider may suspend access to the Professional Area until the balance is settled, keeping the data for the period indicated in the section "Suspension and termination".

s04Obligations.title: 4. Obligations of the user and of end clients

s05Disclaimer.title: 5. Nature of the service: wellness, not medicine
s05Disclaimer.body:
Stress Index is a support tool for wellness and sports professionals. It measures and displays heart rate variability indicators and turns them into scores and trends that help read a person's adaptation, recovery and load.

Stress Index is not a medical device, does not provide a diagnosis, does not prescribe treatment and does not replace the advice of a physician. Scores, thresholds and alerts are statistical wellness indications and do not constitute a medical assessment. Any decision about health must be taken with a physician; in case of symptoms or discomfort, contact the health services.

The professional uses the service under their own responsibility and within the limits of their competence, and agrees not to present it to clients as a diagnostic or treatment tool.

s06Ip.body:
The software, calculation algorithms, interfaces, texts, graphics, the "Stress Index" trademarks and the domain name are owned by the Provider or its licensors and are protected by copyright and industrial property law.

With the subscription you receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable licence to use the service for your professional activity for the duration of the subscription. No other right is granted.

The data you enter and your clients' measurements remain yours and your clients'. You grant the Provider the right to process them to the extent needed to deliver the service, as described in the Privacy Notice. The Provider may use aggregated, anonymous data that cannot be traced back to individuals to improve the service.

The processing of client data is governed by the Data Processing Agreement (DPA), which forms an integral part of these Terms.

s07Liability.title: 7. Limitation of liability
s07Liability.body:
The Provider undertakes to keep the service available and up to date with professional diligence, but does not guarantee that it will be error-free or accessible without interruption. Maintenance work is announced in advance whenever possible.

To the extent permitted by law, the Provider is not liable for indirect damages, loss of profit, loss of data due to causes not attributable to the Provider, or decisions taken by the user or their clients on the basis of information provided by the service. In any case, the Provider's total liability towards the user does not exceed the amount paid by the user for the service in the 12 months preceding the event.

The service depends on third-party providers (hosting, authentication, email delivery, app stores) and third-party hardware (chest straps, smartphones): the Provider is not liable for malfunctions attributable to these parties.

Nothing in these Terms limits liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence, or any other liability that cannot be excluded by law.

s08Suspension.title: 8. Suspension and termination
s08Suspension.body:
You may terminate at any time by cancelling the subscription or requesting deletion of the account at {email}. Termination takes effect at the end of the current subscription period.

The Provider may suspend or close the account, notifying the user, in case of serious or repeated breach of these Terms, non-payment, use that endangers the security of the service, or a request from the authorities.

After the account is closed, data remain exportable for 30 days; after that period they are deleted or anonymized as described in the Privacy Notice, subject to legal retention obligations. It is the professional's responsibility to export their clients' data before closure and to inform them.

The Provider may discontinue the service or individual features with at least 90 days' notice, refunding the unused part of the subscription.

s09Law.body:

The Provider may update these Terms. Material changes are communicated by email or in the reserved area at least 30 days in advance; using the service after the effective date counts as acceptance. If you do not wish to accept them, you may terminate free of charge before that date.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.subtitle: Which cookies and which browser-stored data the stressindex.io website, operated by {company}, uses.

s01What.title: What cookies are
s01What.body:
Cookies are small text files that a website stores in the visitor's browser to recognize them on their next visit or to remember a choice. Besides cookies, a website can also store information in other browser storage areas (localStorage), which stay on the device and are not sent to the server.

This page describes what the stressindex.io website and its Professional Area do. The Stress Index mobile app does not use cookies; the processing of its data is described in the Privacy Notice.

s02Technical.title: Technical cookies used by the website
s02Technical.body:
The website only uses technical cookies, which are necessary for the pages to work or to store an explicit choice made by the visitor. No consent is required for these cookies.

• PROFESSIONAL AREA SESSION: cookies with the "sb-" prefix set by Supabase (the authentication service) when the professional signs in to the reserved area. They contain the session token, keep you signed in and are removed when you sign out. They are not set for visitors who only browse the public pages.

• LANGUAGE: the "NEXT_LOCALE" cookie, set when you choose a language from the switcher (IT / EN / DE). It remembers your preferred language for 12 months.

No other cookies are set by the website.

s03Storage.title: Preferences stored in the browser
s03Storage.body:
In the Professional Area some chart display preferences (time range, metrics shown, hidden series) are saved in the browser's localStorage so that you find them again on your next visit.

This information stays on your device, contains no personal data or measurements and is not sent to the server. It is removed by clearing the site data in your browser settings.

s04Sentry.title: Technical error detection
s04Sentry.body:
To notice malfunctions, the website automatically sends a report to Sentry when a technical error occurs. This service does not set cookies and does not track browsing: it collects the type of error, the point in the program where it occurred, the website version and the browser type, together with a pseudonymous account identifier. Name, email, measurements and notes are not sent.

The details (data processed, storage in the European Union, 90-day retention) are in the section "Technical error detection" of the Privacy Notice.

s05NoProfiling.title: No profiling or advertising cookies
s05NoProfiling.body:
The website does not use profiling cookies, advertising cookies, tracking pixels or traffic analytics tools that identify the visitor. There are no third-party cookies for social networks or advertising campaigns.

For this reason the website does not show a consent banner: none of the cookies used requires one. If tools requiring consent are introduced in the future, this page will be updated and consent will be requested before they are activated.

s06Manage.title: How to manage cookies in your browser
s06Manage.body:
You can view, block or delete cookies at any time from your browser settings (usually under "Privacy and security" or "Site data"). Instructions are available in the help pages of Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge.

Please note that if you block technical cookies, signing in to the Professional Area will not work: without the session cookie you cannot stay signed in. If you delete the "NEXT_LOCALE" cookie, the website will again suggest the language based on your browser settings.

s07Updates.title: Updates to this page
s07Updates.body: This Cookie Policy may be updated when the cookies or tools used by the website change. The date at the top shows the latest revision. For questions, write to {email}.
